title: Uniform local-model Tor bounds extend across finite constructible strata
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and an admissible commutative condensed coefficient ring $\Lambda$: a finite discrete commutative ring annihilated by a power of $\ell$, or one of $\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\Qlb$, where $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is a finite subextension of $\Qlb$, with the condensed objects of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. Fix integers $c\leq d$. Suppose that for every scheme $S$, every $\Lambda_S$-module having a finite constant local model [det-def-sfb-constructible-local-model] has Tor amplitude in $[c,d]$ [det-def-sfb-constructible-tor-amplitude]. Then for every qcqs scheme $X$, every constructible $\Lambda_X$-module [sk-def-sfb-constructible] has Tor amplitude in $[c,d]$. The constructible stratification is a finite partition by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-constructible-stratification], with no assumption that its strata are globally open or reduced.

source.place: Strata, local induction on the number of strata replacing the unsupported globally open-stratum choice
